exact.precio de referencia de OpenRouter; no s: OpenRouter reference price; its providers could not be read
exact.En las vistas de modelos, la capacidad s: In the model views, capability is measured with the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, which AA computes with its own tests and which usually scores a model a few days after release. AA publishes one figure per reasoning configuration; the one with the highest index is shown and named. Alongside it is Epoch AI’s Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) (CC BY 4.0), which combines many benchmarks with a confidence interval and is the basis of the historical series in “The AI Race”. The two scales are not comparable with each other. Matching with OpenRouter is by lab and normalised name.
exact.Precio combinado = (3 × entrada + salida: Blended price = (3 × input + output) / 4, in USD per million tokens, as Artificial Analysis does.
exact.Precio: el que cobra el propio laborator: Price: what the lab itself charges when it serves the model on OpenRouter; if it does not serve it, that of the cheapest provider, named and with its quantisation when OpenRouter publishes it (it may not be the version that AA or Epoch evaluate). The per-model price that OpenRouter publishes is not used because it corresponds to a reference provider that changes from one day to the next. Only the lab’s own prices are recorded as price changes.
exact.«Abiertos» con un repositorio público en: “Open” means a public repository on Hugging Face, linked by OpenRouter or with the same name in the lab’s organisation. Without a repository, Epoch’s classification if there is one; if not, “open · announced” when its OpenRouter description presents it as open-weight (it is not stated who writes it, so it is not attributed to the lab; it counts as open even though it cannot yet be downloaded), and otherwise “closed”, marked as inferred. The licence comes from the Hugging Face model card.
exact.La velocidad depende de quién sirve el m: Speed depends on who serves the model. The median measured by Artificial Analysis at the reference provider is shown, with the same configuration that gives its score; with reasoning at maximum, latency (time to first token) includes thinking time and can reach minutes. If AA does not have it, that of the fastest OpenRouter provider is used when its API publishes it.
exact.Entran los modelos de los laboratorios s: Models from the tracked labs listed on OpenRouter in the last 540 days are included.
